 Jokes aside, we are a team who searches a solution to help farmers and the planet.                 

We want to research possible solutions and apply them so that it is not harmful to farmers, but also restores the planet's health.

All are welcome, no matter age or experience!
summary: The earth is experiencing a serious crisis nowadays, which in part is caused by human recklessness. The urgency behind this crisis is undeniable: if not addressed by all humans, this crisis will cause great damage not only to humans, but to most living beings on earth. NASA does a great job listing some of the characteristics that make up this crisis: shifting temperatures, changing rainfall patterns, and declining soil quality among others. This issues are shown by NASA, the Oregon State University, and USDA among other institutions through various portals (GPM, WSS, PRISM among others). With all this in mind, the question arises: what can be done to solve this problem? The short answer is not much. The long answer is that, to solve this problem, a global, collective effort is mandatory. Fortunately, it is the global age after all, and there is no real limit to what is possible on it. Therefore, Area 52 is pleased to present the idea of R.O.C.A. (Regenerative and Organized Crop Assistant), a global and readily available app that will solve two problems at once, or shoot two birds with one arrow as the saying goes. On one hand, R.O.C.A. will help generate the necessary conscience on people to make the global effort possible. On the other hand, R.O.C.A. will help both big and small farmers (and maybe entrepreneurs outside of agriculture) to find earth-healthy solutions. Area 52 has no shame in saying that R.O.C.A. will become indispensable for farmers today and tomorrow.
details:
The compiled data is then shown to the farmer along with a vast array of produce he can grow. The app will use real-time location, which, when used in combination to the data and models from the mentioned institutions, will showcase the farmer the crops that are suited the best for his piece of land and current cycle. This means that a farmer that uses R.O.C.A. will if his land can grow wheat or corn, and when to switch to legumes to restore the cycle. Alternatively, R.O.C.A. will also tell the farmer if his piece of land is better suited for cattle or the lumber industry. In other words, R.O.C.A. will provide the farmer with the proper counter-measures to every eventuality (droughts or the like) that could happen. Therefore, it can be said that R.O.C.A. is also an encyclopedia of sorts. R.O.C.A.’s reaction capacity and produce information will certainly be indispensable for farmers.

However, it is to be noted, some functions were not added due to time constraints.
